description: Kystbeskyttelsesanlæg is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kystdirektoratet. Coastal Protection Plants is a dataset showing coastal protection structures in Denmark. Coastal protection facilities contain the following types of facilities: • Construction work • Wavebreaker • Boat and bath bridges (updated until 1998) • Dige • Div. Coverage: Kystdirektoratet. The portal shows the English title as "Coastal protection facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Kystdirektoratet. Its keywords include Land use, HVD, INSPIRE. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2026-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
